about: The 3D plant and litter species: chunky designed shapes built in code (growth/pieces.py), where each likes to grow (likes: 0..1 weights on base, damp, shade, wall_foot, edge, seam) and its gates. Sizes are tall (or across for flat things) in centimetres. Colours are sRGB hex, pulled 45 percent toward their own grey so they sit in the style. Gates are exact: a piece whose root is inside footfall 0.6, crown 0.7, keepclear 0.5, a puddle or within 5 cm of litter is never made.

tuning.source: the garden ground builder (g6_tufts.py): at least 8 tuft meshes, scale range 3 to 1, colour pulled 45 percent to grey
